verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs state that broadcasts must first be configured in the UI and can then only be triggered via a single API call, directly contradicting the 'entirely through API' requirement; there is no documented endpoint to create or schedule a broadcast/campaign purely programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for creating/scheduling broadcasts or campaigns (not just triggering pre-built ones), and confirmation that campaign scheduling doesn't require dashboard configuration.
